definitions.explanation: A hole dug in the ground for burying a coffin or remains.
Used figuratively in the expression {墓穴|ぼけつ}を{掘|ほ}る (to dig one's own grave), meaning to cause one's own downfall through careless actions or words.

examples.japanese: {墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The work of digging the grave began.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{棺|ひつぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|お}ろされた→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
examples.english: The coffin was lowered into the deep grave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}り→掘る：00442_horu⟧⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took hours to finish digging the grave in the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧{墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}った→掘る：00442_horu⟧。
examples.english: I dug my own grave by saying something unnecessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嘘|うそ}をついて→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧{墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧な。
examples.english: Don't dig your own grave by lying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁明|べんめい}→弁明：08007_benmei⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、かえって{墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}って→掘る：00442_horu⟧しまった。
examples.english: In trying to justify myself, I ended up digging my own grave.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is much more common in everyday speech than the literal sense. The expression {墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig one's own grave) is a set phrase used when someone's own words or actions lead to their downfall.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig one's own grave — literal and figurative)
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{墓穴|ぼけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig one's own grave oneself)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧: grave, tomb
- ⟦{自滅|じめつ}→自滅：18857_jimetsu⟧: self-destruction
- ⟦{墓地|ぼち}→墓地：15232_bochi⟧: cemetery
